record.field: ('Payment Request _ Batch %s _ %s' % (object.quotation_request_number or '', object.partner_id.name or '')) if ((object.partner_id.lang or '').lower().startswith('en')) else ('طلب سداد _ الدفعة %s _ %s' % (object.quotation_request_number or '', object.partner_id.name or ''))

t.t-value: 1 if line_count <= last_page_capacity else (((line_count - last_page_capacity + lines_per_page - 1) // lines_per_page) + 1)

div.t-attf-class: page sijil2 #{'last dense-last' if is_last_page and len(page_lines) == 9 else ('last' if is_last_page else 'lines-only')} #{'report-en' if is_english else 'report-ar'}

t.t-value: (sale_line.price_subtotal * line.product_uom_qty / quotation_qty) if sale_line and quotation_qty else 0.0

span.t-esc: line.product_id.with_context(lang=report_lang).display_name if line.product_id else (sale_line.with_context(lang=report_lang).name if sale_line else '')

div.t: Please transfer the amount due to the following bank account:
يتم التحويل على الحساب البنكي الآتي
Please include the Payment Request No. in the bank transfer reference.
يرجى ذكر رقم طلب السداد في وصف الحوالة.

t.div: This document is not an invoice.
The electronic invoice is issued after payment.
يتم إصدار الفاتورة الإلكترونية بعد السداد.
